elements.describe: The back of the headlight housing seen from under the hood.
A circular finned plastic cap on the back of the headlight covering the halo (angel-eye) bulb; twists off.
A separate upper compartment on adaptive-headlight cars holding the cornering light bulb behind its own cover.
